title: alnus nana
intro: Alnus nana, commonly known as dwarf alder or alpine alder, is a small shrub or tree species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. Alnus nana has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Alnus nana are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Alnus nana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
